approvalScope: Source-scope approval only for the unchanged candidate 4902a0f1...0a30 (worktree 85444b0, backend pin 695351f). Approved statement: the restricted-domain private-state encoding (canonical public phase in {0,1,2}; all 54 financial/digest limbs privately assigned, range-checked below 2^64, and equality-constrained in-circuit to phase-selected assign_fixed constants from episode.rs; successor limbs selected from fixed constants; phase+1 constrained below 3) is a sound and binding encoding for the fixed-instance predicate 'R2-fixed-first-period-loan-two-transition-IVC-with-fixed-local-authority' under the pinned IvcCircuit/IvcVerifier call structure, and the proposed single bounded experiment (k17, 8GiB, 2 CPU, zero swap, 1800 s, 256 MiB outputs, one attempt, no retry, 299 raw-witness controls + 2 positive recursive steps + proof/decider/accumulator negative controls) is a worthwhile test of that encoding. The two former blocking findings (BF-1 offline dependency closure; BF-2 harness API usage) are withdrawn because the exact pinned manifests and source definitions supplied in the supplement contradict the specific hypotheses on which they rested. This approval does NOT mean: native build/typecheck success (no cargo check was run and none is inferred), MockProver/keygen/prove/verify success, k17 fit or 1800 s feasibility, MC03 completion, general DSL/PCD correctness, ledger compatibility, SRS ceremony trust, OS/toolchain hermeticity, or waiver of the different-VK and verifier-serialization gaps, the full MC01 package acceptance gate, the fresh GPT-6 gate, or the runner's preflight. Hashes, archives, inventories, Git blobs and the supplement's own file digests were NOT tool-verified in this packet-only review; the supplied text is assumed byte-identical to the hashed artifacts.
findings: F1 [private-state-recursive-binding, ACCEPTED on restricted domain, unchanged]: In aggregation/src/ivc/circuit.rs Relation::circuit, prev_state = ivc_gadget.assign(..) (harness assign_full: phase < 3 via assert_lower_than_fixed, each of 54 limbs < 2^64) and circuit_transition (phase < 2; genesis = is_equal_to_fixed(phase, 0); for every i limbs[i] == select(genesis, row0[i], row1[i]) from assign_fixed constants; next limbs = select(genesis, row1[i], row2[i]); next.phase = phase+1 < 3) constrain the same cells later consumed by as_public_input (= [phase]) for the prior-proof public inputs and by circuit_is_genesis. Constraints are global, so any satisfying assignment has limbs = table[phase]; [phase] is injective over satisfiable AssignedStates; a forged non-row-0 genesis or non-row-1 phase-1 predecessor is unsatisfiable. The chain 0->1->2 is bound by SNARK/accumulator soundness only. The supplement's native_chip.rs select (cond*x + (1-cond)*y), is_equal_to_fixed ((x-c)*aux = 1-res, (x-c)*res = 0) and assign_fixed (fixed column + cached constant cell) excerpts confirm the argument-order and constant-binding assumptions previously taken on trust, so former finding F12 (select order) is resolved.

F2 [full-relation, unchanged]: The circuit is a pure fixed three-row table; all 3x54 constants enter via assign_fixed and hence the VK; SHA256/authority/R2 semantics are not recomputed in-circuit, as declared. Checked arithmetic reproduces the fixture (interest 33,972,602; borrowerCash 19,466,027,398; predecessor/output digest chaining consistent between episode.json and episode.rs; limb 3855189194576377326 == LE bytes ee35a694 25628035 of the domain digest).

F3 [unknown-witness-keygen, unchanged and now confirmed]: setup_vk/setup_pk (zk_stdlib/src/interface.rs:494-526) build MidnightCircuit with Value::unknown; assign_full maps over Value without unwrapping; constants are witness-independent; format_public_input's noncanonical-row assert is reached only on genesis(ctx), transition outputs, and post-decider verify paths. Note (documented, not exercised): prove_step after resume_from with a noncanonical state would panic in transition().expect or is_genesis; the harness never does this.

F4 [negative-controls, unchanged]: 299 local raw-witness cases (2 valid edges, 2x54 before/after +1 mutations, row substitutions, 5 edge phases, closed/3/u64::MAX/-1 phases, 54 raw 2^64 limbs, all-u64::MAX boundary) exercise every constraint with expectations consistent with the circuit. Native controls: absent/truncated/altered/appended/cross-step proofs (is_err), 11 decider controls (Err(DeciderFailed) correct because verify checks vk_repr then decider before format_instance), invalid-accumulator control (LHS 1*G, RHS trivial shape; Err(InvalidProof) from the pairing check; relies on the upstream invariant fixed_bases(vk).keys() == fixed_base_labels(cs)).

F5 [negative-controls, former risk now reduced]: The pinned strict-bound path (native_gadget.rs:274-306 -> assert_less_than_pow2 -> assign_less_than_pow2 -> decompose_core) contains no error_if_known_and rejection of out-of-range known witnesses; the only value-dependent check is a #[cfg(not(test))] debug_assert_eq! in decompose_in_variable_limbsizes, which is disabled under the unchanged release profile (workspace Cargo.toml overrides only bench/heap_profiling profiles; the runner passes --release). Overflowing values therefore produce truncated limbs whose reconstruction fails the linear-combination constraint, i.e. an unsatisfied-constraint rejection as the harness expects (checked by hand for phase 3, -1, u64::MAX under bound 3 and for 2^64 limbs under bound 2^64). Residual: if any future profile change re-enables debug assertions, the raw_limb_*_2pow64 and non-canonical-phase cases would abort instead of rejecting; the harness correctly refuses to count synthesis errors as rejections.

F6 [resource-envelope, non-blocking; revised]: MockProver::run at the pin (proofs/src/dev/mod.rs:752-775) ignores the circuit's configured K for domain sizing and selects the minimum n via RowSizer::min_k; Some(K)=17 only sets max_bit_len = 16 for the pow2range chip, and load_table loads only queried tags. If 64-bit range decompositions query a 16-bit tag, the table alone contributes 2^16 rows and the mock domain will still be 2^17; if smaller limbs are chosen, n may be smaller. Neither the mock k nor the per-case time is established; 299 cases could still consume a large share of the 1800 s budget before setup, keygen and two K17 recursive proofs on 2 CPUs. Root accepted this uncertainty; using a smaller LocalRelation K (constraints are identical, only limb chunking changes) or recording a measured timing basis remains strongly recommended but is not required for approval.

F7 [resource-envelope/trust, partially addressed]: The supplement reports that no .cargo/config.toml or .cargo/config exists along the main/frozen worktree and /tmp ancestor paths; the eventual --output path was not selected and its ancestor chain (and $HOME/.cargo/config.toml, since HOME is set to the user's home) must be inspected by the orchestrator before launch, as Cargo discovers config in every ancestor of cwd and in CARGO_HOME. Within the disclosed same-user trust boundary; recommend asserting absence at launch and recording the effective config.

F8 [source-pins-lockfile, resolved by supplement evidence]: source-identity.json (hash-bound, not tool-verified by me) reports that all 421 backendFiles inventory entries match the Git blob bytes of commit 695351f and the current read-only working files; this supplies the commit-to-inventory link previously missing, so prepare()'s HEAD check plus per-file hash copy now ties the compiled tree to the commit. Workspace Cargo.toml (edition 2024, rust-version 1.90.0, Cargo.lock v4) and aggregation/Cargo.toml are consistent with the harness imports and toolchain 1.90.0; the example is auto-discovered and asserts truncated-challenges at runtime (an explicit [[example]] with required-features would be more declarative).

F9 [srs, unchanged and now API-confirmed]: SRS size 25,166,212 = 4-byte k header + 2*(2^17*96) G1 + 2*192 G2 matches ParamsKZG::read_custom RawBytesUnchecked layout (params.rs:281-345); max_k() = g_lagrange.len().ilog2() and g_monomial_size() = g.len() (params.rs:58-76); KZG srs_monomial_blowup returns 1 without single-h-commitment (kzg/mod.rs:118), so the harness's blowup == 1 assertion holds for the truncated-challenges-only feature set. RawBytesUnchecked skips curve/subgroup validation; ceremony provenance beyond the pinned digest is not audited.

F10 [resource-envelope, runner, unchanged]: enforced_limits() correctly refuses to run unless memory.max/memory.swap.max/memory.oom.group/cpu.max/pids.max match (requires cgroup v2 controller delegation and PrivateNetwork support in user units; absence stops the run as designed). resourceUsage reads memory.peak unconditionally: on kernels without it the inner script raises after the run and native-process.json is not written (artifacts survive) - guard recommended. Attempt marker, fresh-output, wall, output-size and disposable-tree cleanup logic are consistent with the envelope.

F11 [private-state-recursive-binding, unchanged]: The exact ordering in IvcVerifier::verify (vk_repr -> decider -> format_instance -> prepare -> assert_empty -> accumulate -> pairing) is load-bearing for the decider controls and for the absence of format_public_input panics; an upstream interface change invalidates this review.

F12 [source-pins-lockfile / BF-1 withdrawn]: Exact cached manifests refute both specific hypotheses: ppv-lite86 0.2.21 depends on zerocopy with features=["simd"] only; zerocopy 0.8.56 lists zerocopy-derive as optional (feature derive, not enabled), as a dev-dependency (not built for non-workspace crates) and under target.'cfg(any())' (always false, so excluded from the target unit graph even though Cargo records it in Cargo.lock); blst 0.3.17 lists glob only under cfg(target_env="msvc"), and cc/find-msvc-tools/shlex are in the reachable set. The four formerly omitted manifests show bellman, serial_test, dhat, blake2, sha3 (zk_stdlib), ark-std, rand_xorshift, criterion (curves), assert_matches, proptest (proofs), dhat (circuits) as dev-only, and criterion/tabbycat/goldenfile-style optionals enabled only where the closure lists them (testing feature of circuits enables goldenfile/serde_json/rand_chacha, all reachable and present). The conservative manifest-only fixed point (119 packages, 112 registry archives all present with lockfile checksums, 268 edges including 4 build edges and 7 proc-macro crates) places all 27 absent archives outside the target graph, consistent with the observation that the same .cargo directory produced the lockfile and previously downloaded exactly the archives needed for native Linux builds. My acceptance relies on the Cargo behaviour that only unit-graph packages are downloaded/required for a build (not the full lockfile), which is Cargo knowledge, not pinned source.

F13 [BF-2 withdrawn, harness API cross-check against pinned definitions]: MockProver::run(&circuit, vec![vec![], vec![]]) matches the two-argument signature at proofs/src/dev/mod.rs:752 (adding a k argument would have been the error). MidnightCircuit::new(&relation, instance, witness, Some(K)), ZkStdLib::configure(&mut cs, (arch, (K-1) as u8)), fixed_base_labels::<S>(..), Accumulator::trivial/new/rhs/check, Msm::new, Point::Variable, ivc::setup::<Loan>(srs, K, ctx), IvcProver::{prove_step, instance, resume_from}, IvcVerifier::verify, IvcCircuit::{cs_degree, arch, format_instance}, IvcError::{DeciderFailed, InvalidProof} (Debug derived, so unwrap/expect compile), ParamsKZG::{read_custom, verifier_params}, Params::{max_k, g_monomial_size} (trait imported), PolynomialCommitmentScheme::srs_monomial_blowup, and the trait bounds (Context: Clone+Debug, State/AssignedState: Clone, Loan: Clone, LocalRelation: Clone with Error: From<plonk::Error>) all agree with the supplied source. The dependency closure is a manifest-only source model (host/target features conservatively unified, Linux GNU predicates, no ancestor Cargo config or custom rustflags, dependency crates' dev-dependencies excluded), not Cargo unit-graph output; my acceptance additionally relies on Cargo downloading/requiring only unit-graph packages rather than the full lockfile, and on the inventoried sparse-index cache (cargoMetadataFiles) covering every locked package needed for --locked --offline resolution, which cannot be checked here.

Feasibility is unknown: no row counts, mock domain sizes, timings, memory peaks, K17 fit, or 1800 s fit are established; the 299 MockProver cases plus clean release build of blst/curves/proofs/circuits/zk_stdlib on 2 CPUs plus K17 keygen and two recursive proofs may exhaust the budget before producing recursive evidence.
